sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சதி அவதாரமே சர்வசக்தி ஸ்வரூபமே பர
ப்ரம்மம் தனைச் சார்ந்த ப்ரம்மசாரிணியே
sections.translit:
sathi avathAramE sarvasakthi swarUpamE para
brahmmam thanaich chArndha brahmmachAriNiyE
sections.en: You are the incarnation of Siva’s consort Sati, the personification of all energies, and a celibate who finally attained reunion with Lord Siva.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
இமவான் தனயே ராஜபோகம் துறந்தே
சதாசிவனிடம் ஒருமனதாய் உறைந்த
sections.translit:
imavAn thanayE rAjabhogam thuRandhE
sadhAsivanidam orumanadhAy uRaindha
sections.en: You are the daughter of the mountain king, Himavan. You renounced all the luxuries of a royal life and lived with a wholehearted focus to attain proximity to Siva.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
நாரதன் கூற்றினை ஏற்று ஊணுறவு விடுத்து
கரமதில் கமண்டலமும் ஜபமாலையும் தரித்து
வெண்துகில் உடுத்து கடுந்தவம் புரிந்த கன்னியே
உள்ள உரமும் இகபர சுகமும் அருளவா தேவி
sections.translit:
nAradhan kUtRinai EtRu UNuRavu vidutthu
karamadhil kamaNdalamum japamAlaiyum dharitthu
veNthugil udutthu kadundhavam purindha kanniyE
uLLa uramum igapara sugamum aruLavA dhEvi
sections.en: You listened to the words of wisdom from Sage Narada, giving up food and detaching from your relatives. You courted a simple life with a mendicant’s waterpot in one hand and a garland of sacred beads in another. You adorned a white saree and performed severe penance like a saint with only thoughts of Siva in your mind. Oh Devi, please come to bless us with a strong mind and happiness in this life and in the future.

notes: Last line charanam word சுகமும் (sugamum) may be replaced with இசையும் (isaiyum). Here the replaced word would mean fame or repute. This song was written for the rendition by Smt. Asha Ramesh on the second night of Navarathri in 2021 on a videocast, organized by a Bay Area volunteer. This song is in praise of Goddess Sati/Parvathi in deep penance with a single goal of attaining Siva after her immolation in the pyre of Daksha’s yagna. The penance was very harsh, She initially lived on fruits and vegetables then switched to dry leaves (hence the name Aparna). Later, she simply turned to air for sustenance. This is the figure or roopam of Devi that is worshipped on the second day of Navaratri. For details see: Story of Brahmacharini Devi Brahmacharini Slokas Brahmacharini Prayers and Benefits
